intent: runtime-split Phase 4 (a+b): repos no longer carry runtime — S1 layout relaxation, wheel-sourced pin manifest, scripts removal, fail-closed stubs
notes: **Phase 4 of the runtime split — the structural change itself.** Governed repos now carry POLICY + PIN only; the runtime executes exclusively machine-side via the Phase 3 dispatcher chain.

**4a — S1 (the plan's highest-risk seam)**: `gator_layout.py::_has_required_includes_content` (both copies) accepts scripts-absent-with-pin as valid v2 — without this, every post-Phase-4 repo resolved invalid, breaking update/init/state fleet-wide. Pins: `TestPinnedScriptlessV2` (3 — pin-no-scripts valid, neither invalid, scripts-no-pin still valid).

**4a — wheel-sourced manifest**: `write_runtime_pin` gains `runtime_dir`; all three callers pass the wheel's template scripts dir, so the manifest hashes the bytes ACTUALLY in force under Variant A — and wheel files never pass through git's autocrlf, largely retiring plan §8 risk 7 for pinned repos. Repo-probe fallback retained for standalone pre-split runs. Pins: `TestWriteRuntimePinRuntimeDir` (3).

**4b — stop shipping**: `gatorize` fresh installs create no `.includes/scripts/`; `plan_updates` skips the scripts overlay (constant kept for migrate_layout classification); `gator-update.py::main` REMOVES `.gator/.includes/scripts/` after a successful pin emission (guarded, v2-only). Contract `test_gator_layout.py` now asserts the Phase 4 shape: scripts-absence + schema-valid wheel-sourced pin on a real gatorize-into-tmp run.

**4b — fail-closed stubs**: `build_git_hook_wrappers` stubs carry an ALWAYS-PRESENT refuse branch — pin present + repo script missing + dispatcher unreachable → pre-commit prints the pipx-install message and exits 1 (never commit ungoverned against a pin); commit-msg/post-commit exit 0 (never strand a mid-flight commit). Closes the mixed-fleet hole where an old-CLI machine would have silently committed ungoverned after a repo went script-less. Pins: blocking-matrix + dispatcher-less-stub tests.
**4b — F2 retired**: the 3 static bash hook files (`templates/scripts/hooks/`) deleted — v1-path dead weight that would have polluted the wheel-runtime manifest (20 → 17 files).

**`gator hook enforcer-review`**: HOOK_MAP gains the post-removal enforcement invocation (non-blocking, passthrough) — repos without `enforcer-review.py` keep a machine-side path to the constitution's enforcement flow (4c documents it).

**DOGFOODED ON THIS REPO — the repo shed its own runtime in this commit**: 33 repo-resident files removed (the ~20 tracked scripts + pycache); pin refreshed to 17 wheel-sourced hashes; layout still resolves v2; pre-commit dispatches through the wheel runtime (it produced the charter-gap findings that shaped this very commit); `gator hook session-open` exit 0; `gator init` reports hooks healthy (S5). THIS COMMIT is the first made by a policy-only Gator repo.
